player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} a wɔre di Pig Dice agorɔ.

Mmara:
- Sɛ eba wo nua, wobɛtumi '[roll]' anaa '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Ka ho wo nua mu
- Roll 1: Di wo nua mu na bɛwie wo nua
- Hold: Ka wo nua mu ho wo akontabuo na bɛwie wo nua
- Kan no {winning_score} akontabuo na edi nkunim

Sɛ eba wo nua, wobɛhunu akontabuo a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ ne wo nua mu.
Kyerɛ '[roll]' sɛ wopɛ roll die anaa '[hold]' sɛ wopɛ boa wo akontabuo.
